title: Self-Evolving Static Analysis via LLM Pseudo-Labeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.30184v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Security bugs often slip past static analysis not because they are impossible to detect, but because detection rules have not yet been written for the code in front of us. New frameworks, APIs, and coding idioms continually create such gaps, leaving developers to discover failures and manually encode new rules. We present SESAA, a framework in which an Large Language Model (LLM) agent starts from no rules and iteratively evolves a set of readable and auditable joern queries.   The agent receives feedback only from a second LLM critic, which inspects flagged and unflagged code to identify likely false alarms and suspected misses, without access to ground-truth labels. The agent then uses this feedback to revise its queries. On the OWASP Benchmark for Python, SESAA reaches a mean F1 of 0.742 across 8 independent runs, well above the default configurations of five widely used tools and comparable to the strongest of them once it is tuned

translated_title: 基于大语言模型伪标签的自进化静态分析
translated_abstract: 安全漏洞之所以能绕过静态分析，往往不是因为它们无法被检测，而是因为尚未针对眼前代码编写相应的检测规则。新框架、API和编码习惯不断制造这种规则空白，迫使开发者先发现故障、再手动编写新规则。我们提出了SESAA框架，让大语言模型（LLM）智能体从零规则出发，迭代进化出一组可读且可审计的Joern查询。该智能体仅从第二个LLM批评者处获得反馈——批评者通过检查被标记和未被标记的代码来识别可能的误报和疑似漏报，且无法访问真实标签。智能体随后根据这些反馈修订其查询规则。在Python版OWASP基准测试中，SESAA在8次独立运行中达到平均F1值0.742，远超五种广泛使用工具的默认配置，并与其中最强工具调优后的表现相当。
tldr: SESAA框架让LLM智能体从零规则开始，仅依靠另一个LLM批评者的反馈（无需真实标签）自进化出可读可审计的静态分析查询规则，在Python OWASP基准上取得0.742的平均F1分数，超越主流工具默认配置并与最优调优结果相当。
